title: gots configuration
description: Configuration file for gots — Go to TypeScript code generator

default_style.description: Default output format for typed constants. union = type Foo = "a" | "b"; enum = enum Foo { A = "a" }; const-object = const Foo = { A: "a" } as const

emit_values_array.description: Generate a companion values array for each typed constant group (e.g., export const FooValues = ["a", "b"] as const)

struct_tag.description: Which Go struct tag to read for TypeScript field names

pointer_handling.description: How Go pointer fields map to TypeScript. optional = field?: T; nullable = field: T | null; both = field?: T | null

empty_interface.description: What Go's interface{}/any maps to in TypeScript. unknown is safer, any is more permissive

header.default: // Code generated by gots. DO NOT EDIT.
header.description: Comment prepended to every generated .ts file

type_map.description: Map Go types to TypeScript types. Key is the full Go type (e.g., time.Time), value is the TypeScript type (e.g., string, Date)

sources.description: Go source files to parse and their output settings. Each source maps a Go file to a TypeScript output file

file.description: Path to the Go source file. Supports absolute paths, relative paths, vendor directories, and paths outside the module

output.description: Path where the generated .ts file will be written

style.description: Override the global default_style for all types in this file

include.description: Whitelist of type/const names to generate. Supports * wildcard (e.g., Message*, *Status). Empty = include everything

exclude.description: Blacklist of type/const names to skip. Supports * wildcard. Applied after include

struct_style.description: Struct output format. interface = export interface Foo {}; type = export type Foo = {}

embed_strategy.description: How embedded structs are rendered. flatten = inline all fields; extends = interface Post extends Base; intersection = type Post = Base & {}

overrides.description: Per-type settings that override source-level and global defaults. Key is the Go type name

style.description: Override the output format for this specific type

values_array.description: Emit a companion values array for this type

name.description: Rename this type in the TypeScript output (e.g., Go FeedbackCategory → TS FeedbackType)

fields.description: Per-field overrides for struct types. Key is the Go field name

type.description: Override the TypeScript type for this field (e.g., Date, Record<string, unknown>)

skip.description: Exclude this field from the generated interface
